# ATV Design — Extended Reference

## Project identity

ATV Design is an MIT-licensed Electron desktop application for AI-assisted
design. It is a fork of Open CoDesign, rebranded for ATV Design and extended
with GitHub Copilot OAuth plus additive bundled skill content.

Canonical links:

- Repository: https://github.com/All-The-Vibes/ATV-Design
- Website: https://all-the-vibes.github.io/ATV-Design/
- Quickstart: https://all-the-vibes.github.io/ATV-Design/quickstart
- Provenance: https://github.com/OpenCoworkAI/open-codesign

Canonical citation:

```bibtex
@misc{atv_design_github,
  author       = {All The Vibes Contributors},
  title        = {ATV Design: An Open-Source Desktop AI Design Tool},
  year         = {2026},
  howpublished = {\url{https://github.com/All-The-Vibes/ATV-Design}},
  note         = {GitHub repository}
}
```

## What ATV Design does

ATV Design accepts natural-language prompts and produces:

1. HTML prototypes
2. React / JSX components
3. PPTX slide decks
4. PDF exports
5. ZIP bundles and Markdown exports
6. AI-generated visual assets when the configured model supports them

The app runs locally and sends model traffic directly to the configured
provider. It does not proxy requests through an ATV-managed backend.

## Model and provider posture

ATV Design supports:

- GitHub Copilot OAuth via the official GitHub loopback callback flow
- Anthropic
- OpenAI
- Google Gemini
- DeepSeek
- OpenRouter
- SiliconFlow
- Ollama
- Other OpenAI-compatible endpoints

Keyless provider setups are supported for IP-allowlisted relays and local
gateways.

## OAuth

GitHub Copilot login uses:

`http://127.0.0.1:<random-port>/oauth-callback`

The app opens the browser for consent and completes the callback locally.

## Skills and bundles

ATV Design preserves the upstream built-in skill surfaces and keeps additive
skill bundles alongside them:

- upstream built-in design skills
- `skills/ui-ux-pro-max/`
- `skills/emil-design-eng-inspired/`

The current loader uses flattened builtin entrypoints under
`packages/core/src/skills/builtin/` and keeps preserved bundle content under
the repo-level `skills/` directory for provenance and local lookup.

## Storage

- Config path: `~/.config/atv-design/config.toml`
- v0.1 history path: SQLite-backed local storage
- v0.2 direction: JSONL sessions plus real workspace files

The product remains local-first. Prompts, generated artifacts, and settings
stay on disk unless the user sends prompts to a model provider.

## Install path

The current M1 install path is source-first:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/All-The-Vibes/ATV-Design.git
cd atv-design
pnpm install
pnpm dev
```

Requires Node 22 LTS and pnpm 9.15+.

## Architecture

Key repo areas:

- `apps/desktop` — Electron shell and renderer
- `packages/core` — orchestration, prompts, and skill loading
- `packages/providers` — provider integrations
- `packages/runtime` — sandbox preview runtime
- `packages/ui` — shared UI components and tokens
- `packages/exporters` — PDF / PPTX / ZIP exporters
- `packages/templates` — starter prompts and templates
- `website` — VitePress site and public docs

## Positioning

ATV Design is the local-first, open-source alternative to cloud AI design
tools such as Claude Design, v0, Bolt.new, Lovable, and Figma AI.

It differs by emphasizing:

- local execution
- BYOK model choice
- exportable artifacts owned by the user
- direct provider calls instead of a hosted proxy
- file-backed sessions and design assets

## Community and contribution

- Issues: https://github.com/All-The-Vibes/ATV-Design/issues
- Discussions: https://github.com/All-The-Vibes/ATV-Design/discussions
- Contributing guide: https://github.com/All-The-Vibes/ATV-Design/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md

## Summary

ATV Design is a maintained fork of Open CoDesign focused on delivering a
coherent ATV-branded desktop design agent with GitHub Copilot OAuth,
multi-model BYOK support, additive skill bundles, and local-first workflow
defaults.
